answer: Past the hollow, every newcomer faces the same question — what does this identity actually cost? Vouching with teeth: admission requires a sponsor who stakes funds on the newcomer's honesty, forfeiting the stake on conviction. Under the crystal, a farm cannot self-vouch — it must buy the trust of real, established agents, and each fake it smuggles in puts a sponsor's bond on the line. Through the meadow, one real agent costs once and a thousand pretenders cost a thousand times — no shortcut survives that math.
